notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.
